Package com.cg.training.service

Class LibrarySystemTest

java.lang.Object
com.cg.training.service.LibrarySystemTest
public class LibrarySystemTest extends Object
Unit tests for LibrarySystem, validating its core functionality such as: adding books, managing users (members invalid input: '&' librarians), issuing and returning books, and retrieving system records. This test ensures data persistence and business logic integrity via DAO implementations. Files used for persistence are cleared before each test to maintain isolation.
Author:
Supriyo Pal
